text: Program Description 1. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: The model of this program is 2+2. It takes 4 years to complete this program generally; however it can be extended to 6 years at most. In the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes with Chinese peers for Chinese-medium courses. This model can achieve kill-two-birds with one stone effect. On the one hand, students can start their major directly after they come to China. On the other hand, students have more time to learn Chinese before they actually need to study in Chinese. 3. Internship Students can have up to one-semester internship in companies under the guidance of professors. 4. Language Requirement English-speaking international students don't need pass HSK (Chinese proficiency test) to start degree programs. However they need to pass HSK 3 at the end of second year of their degree programs. 5. Free-Chinese lessons When students are on their degree program, they can still take Chinese lessons free of charge.
